notes: No shell this run, so I checked everything by hand and did not run `bun tools/plan/cli.ts`. It must exit 0 before acceptance. T2 is now the open U on path 'harbour', so every T2 stop names path 'harbour'. The old Crown Road and Crescent stops are gone because the line no longer runs east along Crown Road.

T-S1 on T2, s measured from (306,320), with each R50 corner as a 78.5 m arc. Stops at s 260, 565, 870, 1360.5, 1796, 2101, about 2531.6. Gaps 305, 305, 490.5, 435.5, 305, about 430.6, all inside 300 to 500. The line leaves the sheet about 180 m after Terraces. T1 gaps stay 308 and 310; S1 gaps are 255, 245, 205.

T-S2: all T2 platforms (±15 m) are on straight track. Terraces (-338.5,150) is 50.6 m along the 80.9 m straight from (-346,100) to (-334,180); its platform (35.6 to 65.6 m) clears both fillets (tangents ~3.7 m from each end). It sits on Sunset Way's walkable median edge. Comet's platform (x -15 to -45) clears the T1 crossing at x 0.

W-3/N-P1/N-P2/W-2: every T2 stop is 0 m off its path and inside its primary road's 24 m carriageway, so each is well within 6 m of the edge. None is on a plot, and each can be reached from the street. On S1, Harbour and Skyport front skyport-pier: Skyport's platform (x 520 to 570) is on the apron and Harbour (340,0) is on the pier.

S-I1/N-C1: T2/harbour (306,60) to S1/harbour (340,0) is 69 m. T2/comet (-30,-726) to T1/comet (0,-690) is 47 m. T1/circus to S1/circus is 119 m. All are within 150, so the three lines form one connected network.

N-R1 by hand. The tightest plots are crescent-north (247 m from S1 Circus), crescent-east (144 m from T2 Harbour Gate) and records-square (193 m from T2 Rocket, 217 m from T1 Records). Others: crown-terraces 196 m from Terraces, lamplight-south-w 181 m from S1 Gardens, docks-south 150 m from Docks. I found no plot over 250 m. crescent-north has only 3 m of margin, so the checker must confirm it.

Spacing forced me off Datum's exact points. The asked pairs (306,-270)/(306,-510) and (-346,-300)/(-346,-560) are 240 m and 260 m apart, below the 300 m minimum. I moved each stop 20 to 40 m along its own street instead: Harbour Court is at -245 (25 m off), Docks at -550 (40 m), Lantern at -585 (25 m) and Rocket at -280 (20 m). Each is still beside its plot.
Still open, carried from Datum: no standard covers the flat T1×T2 crossing at (0,-726), so Keel and Splice need to rule on it. S1 has no station where it passes over T2 at x -340; none is required.
